'''The Rose of Eldar''' is a [[tavern]] in [[Ebou Dar]], located near the [[River Eldar]]. It is a cheap tavern where they keep the dented tin cups chained to benches outside. 

[[Mat Cauthon]] uses The Rose of Eldar as a place to sit and watch a house owned by the [[Kin]]. He sits at the tavern with [[Nalesean Aldiaya]], [[Juilin Sandar]], and [[Thomdril Merrilin]].{{ref/book|7|28}}
